svg.aria-label: Top: final point distributions and score fields, showing 128 generated points. GAN colors are probabilities; WGAN colors are real-valued critic scores. The conditional model uses category labels and an L1 term. Bottom: mode counts among all 2,048 samples within radius 0.24; the dashed line marks uniform allocation of 256 points.
